original_benchmark.notes: 300 text-conditioned LEGO design tasks across 3 constraint settings (100 model <=400 parts, 100 set 400-4000 parts, 100 alt-build using retail set 10698 inventory) and 10 BrickLink categories (10 tasks each per setting), with 5,270 DSG VQA questions (1,719 model + 2,369 set + 1,182 alt-build). Pinned to kulits/BrickAgent@b3df55e36c669b22ef089b13db1ee841907d09b3.

harbor_adapter.notes: WIP adapter awaiting maintainer approval for parity runs and full 300-task oracle sweep. Static generation verified across all 300 tasks; E2E Harbor oracle + negative-control validation performed on 9 representative tasks (3 per setting). Single-trial Harbor reward reports Valid-gated VQA (vqa_gated when valid else 0.0) alongside valid and vqa_flat metrics; pairwise Align/Design ELO remains a multi-system post-run step over saved /logs/verifier/renders/.
